pillars.desc_es: Nos integramos con tu equipo para comprender los cuellos de botella antes de sugerir cualquier software.
pillars.desc_en: We listen and audit your existing workflow before proposing technology.

pillars.desc_es: Traducimos la tecnología compleja en herramientas sencillas que tu personal amará usar.
pillars.desc_en: Translating complex tech into simple intuitive tools your team will actually love.

pillars.desc_es: Cada proyecto tiene métricas claras: horas ahorradas, tiempo de respuesta reducido y mayor retorno.
pillars.desc_en: Focus on clear outcomes: hours saved, reduced turnaround time, higher ROI.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Caprasimo and Figtree in index.html.
Implement language switching state (ES / EN) dynamically affecting all section copies.
Ensure background color is strictly warm cream #F5EAD8 with subtle mosaic tile pattern backgrounds.
Use Lucide icons for services and key UI interactions.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for standard testing.
Do NOT use aggressive high-pressure sales CTAs. Focus on clarity, trust, and professional consultation.
Integrate MongoDB contact submission via FastAPI /api/contact endpoint.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.text_contrast: Ensure text color #201E1D on #F5EAD8 has at least 7:1 contrast.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All buttons, inputs, links, and text blocks MUST contain data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_raw_transparent: Header background must use backdrop-blur and #F5EAD8/85, never raw transparent.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.typography: Use Caprasimo font exclusively for main section titles and logo, Figtree for body and UI elements.
